correctness.rationale: PASS: The weighted beta moment in the monomial basis and s=t/(1-t) substitution give L_n=e^{ic} Gamma(n+alpha+2) U(n+1,-alpha,-ic)/Gamma(alpha+1). The DLMF 13.8.11 fixed-argument large-first-parameter expansion and K-Bessel asymptotic at the principal nonreal z=-ic yield a nonzero complex leading magnitude a^(alpha/2+1/4)exp(-sqrt(2ca)) and phase sqrt(2ca)+c/2-pi(alpha/2+1/4)/2. The error is complex relative O(a^-1/2), hence an absolute normalized real-error rather than a spurious cosine-relative bound. An integral comparison gives O_v(sqrt(N)) phase exponential sums for v≠0, proving sqrt(n) equidistribution. Lower/upper logarithmic² cutoffs and density 1/2 of positive/negative phases yield N±~log²/(4c); exponential damping gives all Schatten classes. Independent exact hyperu moment vs leading computations for alpha=-1/2,0,1 at n=20,80,250 show shrinking relative error; numerical phase fractions approach 1/2. Neither finite tests nor saved VERIFY_OK prove the infinity result.
